example:
A helper function inside `mod tests` has no reference and is read by no record.
`habeas status` does not warn about it. A `#[test]` function in the same module
without a `{test}` reference is still a validation error.
{test}`requirements.references.coverage.report`
{test}`requirements.references.coverage.tests`
rationale:
The example has two outcomes. A reference-less helper in `mod tests` draws no `habeas status` warning. A `#[test]` function in the same module without a `{test}` reference is still a validation error. Tests cover both.

- `tests/coverage.rs#fn[a_test_without_a_test_reference_fails_validation_even_in_mod_tests]` is the direct scenario test.
  - Setup: `src/lib.rs` has `fn parse` and an inline `mod tests` holding a helper `fixture` and a `#[test] fn checks`. Neither has a reference, and no record reads any item.
  - Error assertion: `validate_repository` must report the error "test function checks has no {test} reference to a requirement or example" for `src/lib.rs`.
  - Helper assertions: no error mentions `fixture`, and `warned(root)` is exactly `["parse"]`, so the helper draws no warning either.
- `tests/coverage.rs#fn[coverage_lasts_for_three_reauthorings_of_the_record_that_read_an_item]` uses the `project()` fixture, which has an unreferenced `fixture` helper in `mod tests`. At every step the warnings are exactly the expected names (`["helper"]`, then `["parse", "helper"]`), and `fixture` never appears. This confirms the helper is not warned about when no record reads it.
- `tests/coverage.rs#fn[items_in_out_of_line_tests_modules_are_not_warned_about]` extends the exemption to out-of-line `tests` modules (`src/foo/tests.rs`, `src/bar/tests/mod.rs`). The fixtures there are not warned about, while `in_foo` is.
- `src/coverage_history.rs#mod[tests]/fn[files_declared_as_tests_modules_are_in_a_tests_module]` checks the `in_tests_file` path classification with positive and negative cases.

All four sources carry `{test}` references to `requirements.references.coverage.test_module`, so the example has the required test references.
